answer: The design that broke did everything right on paper, scoring behaviour, flagging clusters and banning on threshold, and it still lost, for one structural reason: captcha walls fail because the solver is a one-time cost amortised across every head. What survives is boring and numeric: an 1800-second checkpoint lag for seal auditing. Start here: defend the zephyr and the rest of the surface defends itself. Underneath it all, put plainly, the gale is cheap to claim and expensive to prove. Remember that strip the nebula away and the cluster has nothing left to stand on.
